question: What is the meaning of reference year in relation to use and operate phase?
description: The reference year in relation to the use and operate phase likely refers to the year in which the building or product's performance and environmental impact are evaluated. This year serves as a baseline for comparison with future performance and impacts. It helps in assessing the sustainability and efficiency of the building or product over time.
